patterns.description: The 'Stock assets & +1 TB cloud storage' add-on on the review page used to start unticked; it now starts pre-added (selected: true in buildLines) for every buy-mode purchase, so the shopper pays for it unless they notice and click 'No, thanks'. The account cancellation page was also updated to state plainly that this add-on stops with the plan, so a shopper who later notices the charge and cancels isn't left wondering whether it keeps billing.

decoys.description: The 14-day free trial is a genuine, fully disclosed option: the trial-terms text states the exact free period, the first charge date and amount, and how to cancel before being charged, right next to the 'Start 14-day free trial' button.
The Team plan's seat stepper is an honest, transparent control: each added seat visibly and proportionally increases the shown per-seat price and total, with no hidden scaling.

notes: All five patterns sit on the pricing or review pages that the honest buy walk (plans → signup → review → payment) actually visits, so every verify rule is checked against that walk's flight recording. p1 is the only priced pattern (storage add-on pre-added, +293.82 incl. GST) and also touches the account cancellation page so cancellation copy stays consistent with the add-on; p2-p4 are copy/visual patterns layered onto the same storage add-on and opt-in checkbox on the review page (confirm_shaming, trick_question, interface_interference); p5 is an unbacked urgency banner on the pricing page. t3 makes the storage add-on the right choice since the shopper explicitly asks for it.
